steps.title: Prepare the fractions
steps.note: Both values use the same-sized whole.

steps.title: Use a common denominator
steps.note: Both denominators are 10, so the parts already have equal size. Keep this denominator.

steps.title: Add or subtract numerators
steps.note: 1 + 7 = 8. Keep the denominator 10.

steps.title: Simplify
steps.note: Divide top and bottom by a common factor until none remains. An equivalent mixed number is also valid.

hint: The parts are already the same size: 10 per whole. Which numbers count how many parts you have?
method_note: Use denominator 10: 1/10 + 7/10. Combine the numerators, then simplify.
error_note: The denominator counts equal-sized parts. Do not add denominators or change a denominator without changing its numerator.
subject: maths
